title: Modernize VB6 Forms to Web Interfaces
problem_statement: The current VB6 forms are outdated and not suitable for modern web applications.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated technology increases security risks and reduces maintainability.
suggested_approach: Refactor forms into web-based interfaces using a modern framework like React or Angular.
success_criteria: All forms are accessible via a web browser.
